_description: Snyk REST `/orgs/{org}/issues` finding → AKSI control mapping. Combines status, severity, type and exploit_maturity into one of {PASS, FLAG, FAIL} verdicts. Open critical/high → PR-03 FAIL. Open medium with mature exploit → PR-03 FAIL (treat as high). Open medium → PR-03 FLAG. Open low → PR-03 PASS (captured, non-blocking). Resolved → PR-05 PASS (audit trail of fix). Ignored without reason → PR-02 FAIL (governance violation). Ignored with reason at critical/high → PR-02 FLAG (re-review required). License high/medium → PR-04 FAIL/FLAG. Container critical → PR-03 FAIL. Unfixable critical/high → PR-03 FLAG (accept-risk). Disregarded → PR-02 FAIL (Snyk bypass = compliance violation).

high_density.description: More than high_density_threshold critical+high open issues in the same project (broken-windows signal)

ai_assisted_concentration.description: More than ai_assisted_concentration_threshold AI-introduced findings in same scan (agent quality drift)

cross_project_pattern.description: Same package_name+package_version with critical issue across more than cross_project_threshold projects (organization-wide exposure)
